hints.title: Sorted Extremes
hints.text: Sorting the array allows repeatedly extracting the minimum element and maximum element from opposite boundary indices.

hints.title: Sum Equivalence
hints.text: Notice that (min + max) / 2 is distinct if and only if (min + max) is distinct, so tracking the pair sum avoids floating-point precision issues.

hints.title: Set Cardinality
hints.text: Record all pair sums in a unique collection and return the size of the collection.

hints.title: Opposite Boundary Sum Collection Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated linear scans for min and max take O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space for sorting and unique sum storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts the array and pairs opposite ends while tracking distinct sums.
